title: Governance, management and monitoring
summary: Keeping costs, rules and resources under control, and seeing what is happening.

policy.clue: Enforces rules on resources, such as allowed regions, and reports what doesn't comply

lock.clue: Stops a resource from being deleted or changed by mistake

tags.clue: Name and value pairs on resources, used to organize them and group their costs

purview.clue: Discovers, classifies and governs data across your whole estate

arc.clue: Manages servers and Kubernetes clusters outside Azure from Azure

arm-templates.clue: JSON files that declare the resources to deploy, so a deployment can be repeated

cloud-shell.clue: A shell in the browser with the Azure CLI and Azure PowerShell already set up

advisor.clue: Personalized recommendations for reliability, security, performance and cost

service-health.clue: Tells you about Azure incidents and planned maintenance that affect your resources

monitor.clue: Collects metrics and logs from your resources and alerts on them

log-analytics.clue: Where you write queries over the log data that monitoring collects

app-insights.clue: Monitors the performance and usage of a web application

pricing-calculator.clue: Estimates what services will cost before you deploy them

cost-management.clue: Reports on what you have spent, and sets budgets with alerts
